messages:
Maya (AE): Starting thread for Cascade Protocol POC. They want to validate a custom-fin tuned 14b and a trimmed 6b fast-embed variant. Need compatibility checklist, EU data residency note, and a split pricing sketch.
Ilya (Solutions Eng): Key compatibility items: tokenizer parity, embedding dim consistency, whether the finetuned 14b changed special tokens, and quant variant naming conventions.
Rohan (SRE): Infra notes: 14b fp16 -> A10/A100 recommended; 6b q4_0 -> T4 pool OK. If they want shared KV cache between variants we need to confirm key shapes. Peak estimate they gave: 40 rps, avg 120 tokens.
Claire (Security): They attached a security questionnaire. Main asks: BYOK for Dedicated, audit export, retention policy (90 days), and subprocess isolation for adapter runtime. EU-only processing required for a subset of traffic. We'll recommend Private if strict.
Dina (Product): Add rollout controls: shadow testing + staged ramp with evaluation hooks. Also include model pinning and variant resolver mapping in the onboarding payload.
Maya (AE): Pricing ask: committed 150M tokens/mo, mixed load (55% gen / 45% embed). Can we give hosted vs reserved Dedicated ballpark?
Ilya (Solutions Eng): Hosted: per-token for gen and embed. Dedicated: map 3 x A10 reserved pool to the commitment. I'll draft a rough comparison.
Ilya (Solutions Eng): Quick onboarding checklist to share:
- artifacts: HF-style model tarball + tokenizer files + optional adapter files
- alias: cascade-fin-14b-v1 and cascade-6b-embed-lite-v1
- sample eval set and perf targets (p95)
- variant mapping file if quant tag used (e.g., cascade-fin-14b:q4_0)

Maya (AE): Can we accept runtime adapters that require custom code? Last time we had to ask customer to merge adapter into weights.
Ilya (Solutions Eng): Hosted disallows arbitrary loading hooks. We can accept merge_on_load or separate adapter files if they follow our whitelist. Otherwise Dedicated/Private is required.
Rohan (SRE): I'll add autoscale suggestion (steady 3 GPUs, burst to 6 for short spikes) and note lead times for dedicated provisioning (~4 business days).
Claire (Security): I'll respond to questionnaire with BYOK flow for Dedicated, recommendations for audit exports, and require signed ATO for Private.
Dina (Product): Action items: 1) @Ilya variant mapping + pricing sketch (ETA Thu) 2) @Claire security answers + EU processing note (ETA Wed) 3) @Rohan sizing and lead time (ETA Wed) 4) @Maya draft customer kickoff with success criteria (ETA Thu).
Maya (AE): I'll request artifacts and the eval set today. Thanks everyone, I'll loop back once I have artifacts.
